name: rock_granite_b
what: warm-grey granite in large rounded slabs: the same SIZE and soft rounded shapes of slabs as the attached stone (about 6-9 per tile, deep crevices between them in a dark warm grey), but each slab is warm grey (#8c8682 to #b4aca6) speckled with small 1-2 px flecks of soft pink feldspar (#c99a8e), pale quartz (#d2ccc6) and dark mica (#4c4644). Not green or sage: warm grey with a faint pink cast. Seamless on all four edges, every cell filled, no border.
